title: Learning-Based Robust Control: Unifying Exploration and Distributional Robustness for Reliable Robotics via Free Energy
summary: A key challenge towards reliable robotic control is devising computational models that can both learn policies and guarantee robustness when deployed in the field. Inspired by the free energy principle in computational neuroscience, to address these challenges, we propose a model for policy computation that jointly learns environment dynamics and rewards, while ensuring robustness to epistemic uncertainties.
